shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/obelisk/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files | head -80 && printf '\\n--- zoom refs ---\\n' && rg -n \"maxZoom|Zoom|supports|isImage\" packages src test tests 2>/dev/null | head -240"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,130p' src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomImageRect.ts; sed -n '1,150p' src/plugins/zoom/ZoomController.tsx; sed -n '1,150p' src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomState.ts; sed -n '1,120p' src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomProps.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/plugins/zoom/index.ts; sed -n '1,120p' src/plugins/zoom/Zoom.tsx; sed -n '1,180p' src/plugins/zoom/ZoomWrapper.tsx; sed -n '1,140p' src/plugins/zoom/props.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; rg -n \"type Slide|SlideCustom|RenderSlideProps|interface LightboxProps|zoom\\?:\" src test/types docs | head -160"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' src/types.ts; sed -n '280,350p' src/types.ts; sed -n '1,130p' src/plugins/video/index.ts; rg -n \"SlideTypes|type:\" docs/examples/custom-slides.md test/types/src/App.tsx | head -100; cat package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "git log --all --oneline -- src/plugins/zoom | head -20; git remote -v; sed -n '1,120p' src/utils.ts; sed -n '1,180p' test/unit/test-utils.tsx; sed -n '1,100p' docs/examples/custom-slides.md"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"type Callback|interface Callback\" src/types.ts; git branch --all --contains HEAD; git log -1 --format='%H %s'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/index.ts; git diff --stat; git diff -- src/plugins/zoom/index.ts src/plugins/zoom/props.ts src/plugins/zoom/Zoom.tsx src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomImageRect.ts src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomState.ts test/unit/plugins/Zoom.spec.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "supports|maxZoom" dist/plugins/zoom/index.d.ts dist/plugins/zoom/props.js dist/plugins/zoom/Zoom.js | head -40; git status --short; git diff --check'
